etymologies.etymologyHTML: From publish +‎ -er.

definitions.definition: A person or (especially) a company who publishes, especially books.

quote.text: All a publisher has to do is write cheques at intervals, while a lot of deserving and industrious chappies rally round and do the real work.

definitions.definition: (programming) A system or component that allows other components (subscribers) to receive notifications of something, such as an event.
(Christianity) A preacher who is a Jehovah's Witness.
